The '''advanced combat system''' artificially enhanced the user's [[nervous system]]. It allowed the impulses to travel faster and farther along the nervous system, quickening reaction time. This implant also improved fine motor control which resulted in increased accuracy, most notably seen with the use of ranged weapons.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 16 or higher.
